pages.title: Dawn Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Before the final advancement 'Though We Fall, We Remain' is earned, killing a Wither at night drops a Dawn Star; once the advancement is earned, it no longer drops.$(br2)§lPurpose: §r The Dawn Star is a smithing material and has no passive effect on its own.

pages.title: Smithing Upgrade
pages.text: Combine the Dawn Template, the Sword of the Free Will and a Dawn Star in a smithing table to upgrade the sword into its enhanced form.$(br2)§lPlacement: §r$(br)Template slot: Dawn Template$(br)Base slot: Sword of the Free Will$(br)Addition slot: Dawn Star
